description: Free / View JSON: request view=facts with a listed product_id, optional exact filters and limit (1..20). Use view=free_result for an entirely free offer, with optional filters.identifier and filters.choice. No wallet. For original discovery use {"view":"tasks","task":"exact_historical_evidence","subject":"postgresql"} to choose by historical task and held output, or {"view":"summary","limit":64} for the short offer index. Read {"product_id":"<exact listed ID>"} alone for the public contract, copyable input and POST /v1/prepare/{product_id} for an unsigned quote. GET /v1/x402/binding-example for an offline example. Omitting view/product_id preserves the full catalogue, default3 and limit1..64/next_cursor. Zero task cards is not zero vulnerabilities; a summary or schema enum is not MATCH or current applicability.
name: foundry_products
